name: Galadriel
subtitle: Lady of Light
game_text:
At the start of each of your turns, heal every ally whose home is site 6.
<phase>Fellowship</phase>: Exert Galadriel to play an Elf for free.
flavor_text: “Very tall they were, and the Lady no less tall than the Lord; and they were grave and beautiful... and the hair of the Lady was of deep gold....”
